title: Privileged access is restricted to approved users.
description: Only approved users should hold privileged authorities on production objects.

title: Dormant privileged accounts are disabled or justified.
description: Inactive privileged accounts should be disabled or supported by documented approval.

title: Public authority to sensitive objects is restricted.
description: Sensitive files and programs should not grant excessive public authority.

title: Audit logging is configured for security-relevant events.
description: Security-relevant events should be logged and retained.

title: Audit evidence is reviewed and retained.
description: Audit evidence should be reviewed on a defined cadence.

title: Security-relevant system values are configured and reviewed.
description: System values affecting security should be reviewed and justified.
